test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Raghav starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point P? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution: According to information given: 1) Raghav starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the north. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52f2950992fbb6a98fa9c1d3aa0cd1346d54f5c1b088f797f70a6deff92343c1.png] 2) He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 13 km.
